name: surrealdb/surrealdb.php
description: The official SurrealDB SDK for PHP.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: PSR-18 HTTP client and PSR-17 factories used by the default HTTP engine
suggest.php-http/discovery: Automatic discovery of the installed PSR-18 client and PSR-17 factories
suggest.openswoole/core: Run the SDK on OpenSwoole coroutines (native async WebSocket client and non-blocking HTTP via runtime hooks)
suggest.revolt/event-loop: Fiber-based event loop powering the Amp runtime (e.g. FrankenPHP worker mode)
suggest.amphp/websocket-client: Async WebSocket transport for the Amp/Revolt runtime
suggest.amphp/http-client: Non-blocking HTTP transport for the Amp/Revolt runtime
suggest.amphp/http-client-psr7: Non-blocking PSR-18 client for OTLP export on the Amp/Revolt runtime (Runtime::amp with ObservabilityOptions)
suggest.open-telemetry/api: Emit OpenTelemetry traces and metrics via the bundled SurrealDB\SDK\Telemetry\OpenTelemetry adapter
suggest.open-telemetry/sdk: Configure OpenTelemetry providers via the runtime-aware observability presets (Runtime::sync/swoole/amp with ObservabilityOptions)
suggest.open-telemetry/exporter-otlp: OTLP exporter used by the runtime-aware observability presets to ship traces and metrics

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan static analysis on the source tree.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Check code style without writing changes (php-cs-fixer dry-run + diff).
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Apply code-style fixes, incl. `use function` imports for compiler-optimized native calls.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run static analysis, code-style checks, and the default PHPUnit suite.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full suite on the default synchronous PHP-FPM/CLI driver (sync scheduler).
scripts-descriptions.test:openswoole: Run the OpenSwoole coroutine runtime suite (requires the openswoole extension).
scripts-descriptions.test:frankenphp: Run the FrankenPHP / Amp (Revolt) runtime suite (requires revolt/event-loop).
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Run every suite: default (sync) + OpenSwoole + FrankenPHP.
